_comment: Config for scripts/audit-closing-dates.js. Edited by hand; not auto-generated. Established pattern (cf. data/dtli-slug-map.json).

slugOverrides._comment: show.id → broadway.com slug, when stripping the year suffix from id doesn't produce the URL broadway.com actually uses. Probe via curl https://www.broadway.com/shows/{slug}/schedule/. Verified 2026-05-14.

openRunSkip._comment: Open-run long-runners that broadway.com doesn't sell directly (Telecharge / own-site only). Audit can't observe their schedule, so skip silently. Remove an entry when the show announces a close — the audit will then surface a NEW_CLOSING candidate.

ambiguousAllowlist._comment: Shows where stored closingDate is human-verified correct but broadway.com's ~5-month schedule window cuts off earlier. Audit treats these as MATCH (not AMBIGUOUS) as long as stored matches the verifiedStored value. If the show extends/retracts, stored diverges from verifiedStored → entry auto-bypassed → normal ambiguous path resumes. Add an entry after manually confirming via Variety/Playbill/Deadline that the stored date is the announced final performance.

oh-mary-2024.source: BRO-4753: no announced final performance; rolling booking. broadway.com schedule lists dates into Mar 2027 with more behind View All (2026-10-12); the 2027-01-17 press date is Bowen Yang's cast extension (https://www.broadwayworld.com/article/Bowen-Yang-to-Extend-OH-MARY-Broadway-Run-Through-Mid-January-20260924), not a show close.

schmigadoon-2026.source: BroadwayWorld 2026-09-08: second extension, 13 more weeks to Apr 4 2027 (https://www.broadwayworld.com/article/SCHMIGADOON-Extends-on-Broadway-Through-April-2027-20260908); Broadway News exclusive confirms

school-girls-or-the-african-mean-girls-p.source: BRO-4753: Broadway.com Buzz extension through Nov 15 (https://www.broadway.com/buzz/207745/); Playbill + Broadway News agree. The POSSIBLY-CLOSED flag came from a 404 at the wrong broadway.com slug (slugOverride added).
